name: Agent-First Slug
synopsis: Rust slug generation with explicit caller configuration for path and URL path segments.
intent: Provide a reusable slug primitive where callers configure character classes, dots, transliteration, truncation, empty behavior, and validation instead of relying on hard-coded product rules
Keep the library generic: no presets, downstream project names, hidden fallback words, or built-in legacy modes
Provide a small afslug CLI that applies the default rules and emits AFDATA protocol events for one-off use
Publish the agent-first-slug skill with explicit Rust library and afslug CLI workflows
Make slug generation deterministic and test-covered so callers can preserve or migrate their own identifiers intentionally
mutations: Route every help request through the shared agent-first help renderer: the default is scoped structured JSON for one command level, --recursive returns a compact full-tree index, and --output plain restores conventional human help.
Drop clap's help pseudo-subcommand and replace the eager help dump on a missing command with a compact structured error carrying a 'try: afslug --help' hint.
Make --version always emit a structured AFDATA protocol result and remove the -V short alias so version discovery has exactly one machine-readable shape.
Add a global --output-to flag (split, stdout, stderr) that defaults to split, sending result events to stdout and error events to stderr, with stdout selectable for a single ordered event stream.
Upgrade the Agent-First Data dependency to 0.26.0 for the unified version/help pre-parser and output-routing emitter.
Add a release workflow that builds macOS, Linux, and Windows binaries and publishes the checksums Homebrew and Scoop packaging consumes.
